document_kind: Descriptive interface snapshot for the research archive; not executable configuration or agent instructions.
goal: CUMCM 2026 B: Q1/Q2 mathematics and reproducible Q3/Q4 research with 20 user-supplied official practice observations. Official formal scores, six encrypted logs and actual contestant manual review remain unavailable.
python: conda run -n py314 python; dependencies in requirements.txt
state_semantics: One source at most per channel. A no_signal response alone cannot certify absence or remove a radius-1000 disk in Q4. Error is fixed at each coordinate/channel, bounded, not assumed IID. Clear never changes the radio channel. Coordinates outside the arena are legal. Different actions are serialized; only accepted actions advance state.
planner_interface: run.py and official_run.py default to FieldPlanner through --strategy field; --strategy refined preserves Planner's original 20-practice algorithm. Both problems use probe_scale=0.22. Q3: seven radius-1200m ring/origin anchors, center joint dispatch, unknown scanning. Q4: compact25 origin plus 12 radius-940m and 12 radius-1870m anchors, outer phase 15deg, guarded/useful. Field adds bounded route_portfolio and at most one pre-localization in-place premeasure. Q3 only adds no_signal conservative inner-16-gon exclusion/convex outer hull and safe-circle-intersection approach clear. Q4 forbids negative-disk inference and approach_clear=False. Fixed up-to-six probes plus at most one prediction, bounded recovery and rectangle optical fallback remain. Historical enhanced remains a separate comparator; Planner itself retains refined default for historical callers.
scan_certificate: Unknown channels retain every discovery-anchor measurement obligation. Only accepted anchor observations enter scan_records. Known tracks may skip redundant anchor measurements: unknown skips all known tracks; useful skips tracks with enclosing radius <=19.9m or anchor-center distance minus radius >1500m. Skips never count as observations or absent evidence. Detected tracks remain detected until cleared. Stop only when every channel is cleared or coverage-certified absent, or 16 distinct channels are cleared.
geometry_interface: geometry.py: Point=tuple[float,float]; initial_polygon(sides=180) circumscribes the 1800m disk; clip_bearing(...,error_deg=1.005) conservatively clips angular halfplanes plus range projection cap; diameter and enclosing_circle evaluate the feasible polygon. optical_cover(...,radius=19.9) covers the whole polygon using the retained rectangle construction. A diameter <=40m alone is not the radius-20 clearing criterion.
coverage_interface: coverage.py retains legacy omni_waypoints and directional_waypoints APIs for historical comparisons. Refined and field Q3 use ring_radius=1200. polar_coverage_candidate.py supplies compact25 and its certificate for Q4. fast25 remains an internal rejected candidate; temporary --coverage-policy CLI is removed. Slab optical and other candidate modules remain shipped for exact historical development reproduction, not default or recommended official trials.
environment_interface: LocalSimulator(seed, problem=3, error_mode='smooth', scenario='random').act(path, position=None, channel=None) exposes public response semantics only. summary() is for evaluation after exit and includes actual n_sources, n_cleared, virtual_time_s, average_time_s, distance_m, measures, switches, clear_attempts, failed_clears and real_duration_s. Modes smooth/extreme/iid_location are synthetic models, not an official error distribution.
client_interface: HTTPClient(base_url, robot_id, log_path).act(...) serializes actions with idempotent same-request retries and accepted-state handling; close() releases resources. official_run.py requires --problem, --robot-id and a new --output-dir, optionally --base-url. It connects only to a GUI-authenticated, already-ready session; it does not launch the GUI or select a test.

research_evidence.comparison: Per-world T/N, matched seeds; runs are not independent-world counts. Development and holdout denominators are separate.

field_evidence.limits: Local paired evidence only, not official improvement; Q4 clustered/smooth saving CI crosses zero. Both main field groups clear 1000/1000 worlds. Development and confirmation remain disjoint.

practice_reproduction: Canonical official_analysis.py reads adjacent ai_optimization_handoff_20260912 by default; extracted archive runs --handoff practice_data. Manifest and 60 sanitized raw files are preserved byte-for-byte, range/robot_id=TEAM_REDACTED checked and individually hash-bound. All 20 traces are independently costed using actual requests and responses; StrictReplay completes only 8/20 and stops at first unmatched action without invented feedback. N/types/case labels are offline only; no formal encrypted logs are included.
delivery: Anonymous whitelist archive with SHA-256 manifest, <=20MiB per deliverable and abstract/body<=30 page checks. Clean temporary extraction removes PYTHONPATH, replays all seven core datasets: 4430+3080+2200+2550+10700+2250+9400=34610 runs, not worlds. fast_vs_compact_410's 2000 auxiliary runs stay separate. Full ordered JSON comparisons exclude only local real_duration_s/max_real_duration_s/max_real_s; official runtime observations remain exact. Source/practice and five asset-metadata input hashes are checked before and after replay; official raw files are not regenerated. All new modules/scripts and notes ship; appendix includes all necessary executable source. Final proof must bind current ZIP hash; these contracts do not claim actual passing verification or manual review. Original problem documents are repository references, not archive dependencies.
